name: garcia-refined
prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit / production pixel-art refinement.
Refine the existing game sprite toward the approved concept, at THREE TIMES its previous native drawing density. The silhouette will occupy about 96 source pixels in a 144x144 export cell, displayed at the SAME in-game world size as before. Add real drawn pixel detail, do not merely enlarge the old 32px artwork, and do not produce coarse giant pixel blocks.
OUTPUT: one transparent production sprite sheet, EXACTLY SIX equally spaced columns and TWO rows, TWELVE occupied cells total, no gutters with labels, no text, no scenery, no shadow, no weapons or hands. Same character and upright concept-facing projection in every cell, no visible face, no front-facing body illustration, no extra costume parts.
Top row: six restrained walking body poses, first and fourth neutral, shoulders/cloth sway slightly in the opposite phases.
Bottom row, left to right: neutral IDLE; DASH neutral start; DASH compressed pose; DASH impulse pose; DASH recovered neutral; neutral IDLE again.
Keep dimensions and bottom-center anchor stable across all cells. Motion is subtle, costume and hat geometry remain the same. Prioritize precise outlines and clean stepped contours, grouped shading, restrained material textures. A few 1–2 source-pixel details are useful, but no noisy dithering. Closely controlled warm outlines, 40–64 useful colors per character, no antialiasing or blur. The 1080p display should read the straw weave, stitching, insignia or fringes clearly while preserving the charming old pixel-art western style. No glow, no painterly gradients, no photorealistic rendering. Retain full transparency. Character is ONLY GARCIA, second column of concept image 1. Image 2 is the coarse existing animation to refine. Charcoal military hat with broad oval brim and a short raised crown, a small cream star-and-cord insignia; blue-violet squared shoulders and a distinct red tied neckerchief. Improve the hat seam and restrained warm rim highlight, make the insignia clear without becoming a giant emblem, articulate the separate scarf knot and two cloth tails, add one small highlight seam on each sleeve. No gold epaulettes or other new costume, no face or legs. Keep the same raised-crown concept projection, not a flat disk. No Poncho or other characters.
